---
title: "No free refills: prior drying and vertebrate colonization alter ecological functioning and vertebrate fitness within experimental aquatic systems"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
#Journal of Freshwater Biology
#Manuscript FWB-P-Sep-22-0415
#Amphibian Analyses

#Load packages required for analyses
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(car)
library(multcomp)
library(lattice)
library(effects)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggformula)

#Selecting working directory (subject to change)
setwd("C:/Users/krist/Dropbox/WSU Grad Research/1_Ward Mesocosms 2021/Field Data")

#Selecting Excel data sheet
AData <- read_excel("Emergence and Biomass.xlsx")

#Allocating each variable as a factor or numeric variable
AData$Treatment <- as.factor(AData$Treatment)
FrogData <- AData[AData$Emerged>0,]
FrogData <- droplevels(FrogData)
FrogData$Pred_Invert <- as.factor(FrogData$Pred_Invert)
FrogData$First_Emerg <- as.numeric(FrogData$First_Emerg)
FrogData$Meta_Range <- as.numeric(FrogData$Meta_Range)
FrogData$Size_Range <- as.numeric(FrogData$Size_Range)
FrogData$Avg_Mass <- as.numeric(FrogData$Avg_Mass)
FrogData$Wmax <- as.numeric(FrogData$Wmax)
FrogData$K <- as.numeric(FrogData$K)
FrogData$xm <- as.numeric(FrogData$xm)
FrogData$Treatment <- factor(FrogData$Treatment, levels = c("A:ND", "A:DR"))
```


```{r}
#Analyzing the number of emerged frogs (survival) between Dry-refill  and Non-dried treatments via ANOVA
Femerged1<- glm(Emerged ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(Femerged1,type=c("II"))
summary(Femerged1)

#Graphing the above ANOVA via a vertical box plot
ggplot(FrogData, aes(x=Treatment, y=Emerged)) + geom_boxplot(size=1) + theme_classic() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("A:ND", "A:DR")) + stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape=17, size=2)+ ylab("") + xlab("") + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size =12)) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12))


```


```{r}
#Analyzing differences in amphibian emergent biomass between Dry-refill and Non-dried treatments via ANOVA
Biomass1<- glm(Emergent_Biomass ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(Biomass1,type=c("II"))
summary(Biomass1)

#Graphing the above ANOVA via a vertical box plot
ggplot(FrogData, aes(x=Treatment, y=Emergent_Biomass)) + geom_boxplot(size=1) + theme_classic() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("A:ND", "A:DR")) + stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape=17, size=2)+ ylab("") + xlab("") + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size =12),axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

```


```{r}
#Analyzing differences in average amphibian metamorph size (dry mass) between Dry-refill and Non-dried treatments via ANOVA
Size <- glm(Avg_Mass ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(Size,type=c("II"))
summary(Size)

#Graphing the above ANOVA via a vertical box plot
ggplot(FrogData, aes(x=Treatment, y=Avg_Mass)) + geom_boxplot(size=1) + theme_classic() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("A:ND", "A:DR")) + stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape=17, size=2)+ ylab("") + xlab("") + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size =12)) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

```


```{r}
#Analyzing time to first emergence between Dry-refill and Non-dried treatments
Ftime<- glm(First_Emerg ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(Ftime,type=c("II"))
summary(Ftime)

```



```{r}
#Analyzing size range differences with an interaction between drying treatment and range of amphibian Metamorphosis
#The "*" symbol represents an interaction between the two variables on either side of the symbol
Srange<- glm(Size_Range ~ Treatment*Meta_Range, data=FrogData)
Anova(Srange,type=c("III"))
summary(Srange)

#Graphing the above interaction 
ggplot(Srange, aes(Meta_Range,Size_Range,colour=Treatment,fill=Treatment)) +
  geom_smooth(span = 0.5,method="glm",alpha=0.2)+
  geom_point(size=0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("blue", "red"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue", "red"))+
  theme(legend.position = "top",plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  ggtitle("")+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size =12),axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

```


```{r}
#Analyzing differences in Wmax (Gompertz growth curve parameter representing maximum larval size) via ANOVA
Wmax <- glm(Wmax ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(Wmax,type=c("II"))
summary(Wmax)

#Analyzing differences in K (Gompertz growth curve parameter representing maximum growth rate) via ANOVA
K <- glm(K ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(K,type=c("II"))
summary(K)

#Analyzing differences in xm (Gompertz growth curve parameter representing time that the replicate reached its max growth rate) via ANOVA
xm <- glm(xm ~ Treatment, data=FrogData)
Anova(xm,type=c("II"))
summary(xm)
```


```{r}
#Gompertz Growth curve lines for each tank
T2 = function(x){3.079*(exp(-exp(-0.122*(x-17.05))))}
T4 = function(x){3.622*(exp(-exp(-0.104*(x-18.57))))}
T5 = function(x){2.803*(exp(-exp(-0.115*(x-16.54))))}

T21 = function(x){2.740*(exp(-exp(-0.174*(x-14.39))))}
T22 = function(x){3.542*(exp(-exp(-0.118*(x-17.68))))}
T52 = function(x){3.219*(exp(-exp(-0.093*(x-18.94))))}
T53 = function(x){3.649*(exp(-exp(-0.092*(x-19.41))))}

T9 = function(x){5.770*(exp(-exp(-0.226*(x-18.00))))}
T14 = function(x){5.959*(exp(-exp(-0.133*(x-18.05))))}
T27 = function(x){4.006*(exp(-exp(-0.228*(x-15.21))))}
T34 = function(x){5.169*(exp(-exp(-0.224*(x-14.79))))}
T40 = function(x){4.527*(exp(-exp(-0.181*(x-15.88))))}
T45 = function(x){5.306*(exp(-exp(-0.094*(x-20.98))))}
T51 = function(x){4.173*(exp(-exp(-0.267*(x-14.17))))}
T54 = function(x){6.202*(exp(-exp(-0.170*(x-16.98))))}
```

